avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces tipranavir levels by up to 75%, causing treatment failure and resistance development
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all St. John's Wort products

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may significantly reduce tipranavir plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; culinary amounts acceptable

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have weak CYP3A4 inducing effects; limited clinical data in HIV patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; consider alternative hepatoprotective if concerned

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases tipranavir absorption significantly; inconsistent dosing may reduce efficacy or increase toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Take tipranavir with food consistently; avoid variable fat intake around dosing time

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase tipranavir levels; effect typically modest with protease inhibitors
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; not absolutely contraindicated but recommend patient consistency

monitoring_notes: Tipranavir is a substrate and inducer of CYP3A4 with significant interaction potential; adherence to food intake requirements is critical for consistent bioavailability. Monitor viral load, CD4 count, and hepatic function regularly, especially when initiating or discontinuing interacting agents.
